findings.title: Group title sanitizer does not strip Unicode control/format characters before the name is rendered on the board
findings.description: This commit turns Group.title into displayed chrome in four places (GroupHeader.svelte:19, CollapsibleGroup.svelte:42, GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:30, plus the hint switch in EmptyState.svelte:11). HTML injection is fully closed — every sink is a Svelte {} text interpolation. What is not filtered is the Unicode layer: sanitizeGroupTitle() (src/data/migration.ts:45) only applies trim() + slice(0,40) + a lone-high-surrogate repair, and String.prototype.trim() removes ECMAScript WhiteSpace/LineTerminator only, not category Cf/Cc code points. Two consequences now become visible because the value reaches the DOM: (a) a bidi override such as U+202E (RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE) placed in the title changes the visual order of the rest of the header line, so the task counter '(3)' and the settings/add glyphs — and the whole 'Group settings: <name>' popup heading — can render reversed or repositioned relative to what the data actually says; (b) a title consisting only of zero-width characters (U+200B, U+FEFF) survives trim(), so it is 'non-empty' for both resolveGroupTitle() and the EmptyState renamed-check: the header shows a visually blank name instead of the localized default, and an empty group silently swaps its semantic hint for the neutral emptyState.renamed one. The data path is not purely self-authored — data.json travels through Obsidian Sync and shared/git-backed vaults, so the string is not guaranteed to have been typed by the person looking at the board.
findings.location: src/data/migration.ts:45 (sanitizeGroupTitle); rendered at src/ui/GroupHeader.svelte:19, src/ui/CollapsibleGroup.svelte:42, src/ui/GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:30
findings.impact: Visual misrepresentation of board chrome only — no script execution, no data access, no privilege change. Worst realistic case is a group header or settings-popup heading that reads differently from the stored data, or a group that looks unnamed while behaving as renamed. Requires a hand-edited or externally supplied data.json.
findings.recommendation: Filter format/control code points in the existing sanitizer rather than at the render sites, so name and hint stay derived from one rule: `return value.replace(/[\p{Cc}\p{Cf}]/gu, '').trim().slice(0, GROUP_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH).replace(/[\uD800-\uDBFF]$/, '');` — stripping before trim() also makes a zero-width-only title collapse to '' and fall back to the localized default. Note this line belongs to Task 03's file and is outside this commit's diff; raised here because Task 06 is what makes the value user-visible. Deferring it to Task 08 (where the input field lands) is acceptable — but the fix belongs in the load-side sanitizer, not only in the input.

findings.title: EmptyState dereferences the new groupTitle prop without the defensive guard its sibling components use
findings.description: EmptyState.svelte:11 calls `groupTitle.trim()` on a required prop declared as `export let groupTitle: string` with no default. The three header/popup sites added in the same commit all read the same field defensively (`group.title ?? ''` in GroupHeader.svelte:15, GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:11, CollapsibleGroup.svelte:31), and both current EmptyState call sites do pass `?? ''` (TaskGroup.svelte:36, CollapsibleGroup.svelte:75) — so today the value is always a string. The asymmetry is the issue: if a future render site omits the prop, or a value that is neither string nor null/undefined reaches it, the reactive statement throws during render. Because EmptyState renders inside the board tree, a TypeError there aborts the whole board render, not just one group — the exact failure mode migration.ts:9-10 explicitly designs against ('an exception on hand-edited data would leave the user with no board at all'). The Svelte compiler does not enforce prop presence at runtime, so TypeScript typing is not a runtime control here.
findings.impact: Availability of the entire board view, not just one group, if a call site or data shape ever drifts. Not reachable through the current code paths: every dataStore write goes through migrateData(), which guarantees group.title is a string (src/main.ts:52, src/settings.ts re-sets the already-migrated object, tests/harness/main.ts:94).
findings.recommendation: Give the prop a default and keep the trim() rule intact — `export let groupTitle = '';` — or normalize once at the top: `$: renamed = String(groupTitle ?? '').trim() !== '';`. Either keeps the single trim()-based renamed-check the task requires (still one hit for the `grep -n "trim()"` verification step) while matching the `?? ''` posture of the other three components.

findings.title: Group settings popup heading renders the user-supplied name with no wrapping or truncation
findings.description: The commit hardens both header rows against a maximum-length name (min-width:0 + overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis + white-space:nowrap on the two titles, flex-shrink:0 on the six siblings), which is exactly what the task asked for. The third new display site was not covered: `.tm-popup__title` (src/styles.css:663-668) sets only margin/font/color, and the heading concatenates a localized label with the name (GroupSettingsPopup.svelte:30) inside a container capped at max-width:420px with 1.25rem padding. A 40-character name with no break opportunity (a single unbroken word, or CJK/emoji at wider advance) can overflow the popup box horizontally, since a long unbreakable word does not wrap by default.
findings.impact: Cosmetic layout overflow in a modal the user opened themselves. No content is hidden or spoofed, no control becomes unreachable — the popup's action buttons live in a separate flex row. Listed for completeness because it is the one of the three new name-display sites left without the length hardening applied to the other two.
findings.recommendation: Add `overflow-wrap: anywhere;` (or `word-break: break-word;`) to `.tm-popup__title` in src/styles.css. Strictly speaking this is beyond Task 06's stated eight selectors, so folding it into Task 08 — which adds the editing input and will exercise long names interactively — is a reasonable call.

verifiedClean: No {@html} anywhere in src/ — the only match is the prose warning in the groupTitle.ts docblock. All four new display sites use {} text interpolation, which Svelte escapes at compile time.
No innerHTML / outerHTML / insertAdjacentHTML / document.write / eval in src/.

The group name never reaches an attribute, style binding, tooltip or data-* value. Every title= attribute in the touched components carries an i18n key ($t('groupHeader.settings'), $t('groupHeader.addTask')); the only style bindings are numeric (--tm-card-columns: {columns}); data-group-id={groupId} is a fixed GroupId union member, not user text.
src/ui/groupTitle.ts is untouched by commit 8dfff69 (absent from the diff's file list) and still exports exactly one function, per Task 05's constraint.

Every path that populates dataStore runs migrateData() first (src/main.ts:52 then :21/:45; src/settings.ts re-sets the same migrated object; tests/harness/main.ts:94), and its sanitization block sits outside all version branches (src/data/migration.ts:154-159), so group.title is a trimmed string of at most 40 UTF-16 units on every load — the unbounded-length-in-DOM concern is covered, including the lone-high-surrogate repair after slicing.
The 40-char cap plus the new overflow:hidden on both title spans also clips a stacked-combining-mark ('Zalgo') title to the span's box, so that variant cannot bleed over neighbouring chrome.

The renamed-check uses the same trim() emptiness rule as resolveGroupTitle(), so the displayed name and the empty-state hint cannot disagree; it appears exactly once, in EmptyState.svelte (no duplicate in TaskGroup.svelte or CollapsibleGroup.svelte).
No hardcoded secrets, credentials, tokens or keys in the diff. No new dependencies, no network calls, no deserialization of untrusted input introduced.
npm run build succeeds; the only warnings are the pre-existing a11y notices on the popup overlay divs, unchanged by this commit.
